title: SshCertRequest
description: The session's ssh-agent needs a certificate for its in-memory key (remote-servers.md §4.2–4.5). Unreliable, req_id; the console checks the session belongs to this node with this open_gen (§2.3) and answers ssh.cert_response. Never logged.

public_key.description: The session's ephemeral public key, one OpenSSH authorized_keys line (ssh-ed25519 AAAA…).
